contexts.text: When the Angels merely look into anyone, they at once know his quality.
If man were looked at by the Angels close at hand...
Evil Spirits cannot endure that the Angels should look at them... for they are tortured...
They are explored by... being inspected by the Angels; and when they are inspected, the higher part of the head appears to be withdrawn...
When the Angels look into evil Spirits, the latter appear quite different... Example(s).
The Angels inspect the evil whenever they notice that they are struggling out from their Hells into the World of Spirits...
When (the appearances in Hell) are inspected by the Angels, they appear like phantasms and disappear; and the infernals themselves appear... as monsters.
When the Angels look at any Spirit who is in evil, he appears to be turned into something inanimate... Explained.
Hence it is that when the Angels look at anyone, they infuse into him the affection which is of their life.
To look into the Hells... is sometimes granted to good Spirits.
When an evil Spirit is merely looked at by the Angels, he falls into a swoon, and does not appear as a man; and this until the Angel averts his eyes. Explained.
(In examining a man after death) the Angels inspect his face...
When it is granted to inspect the interiors and exteriors of thought and affection of those who are in celestial love...
When these places (of instruction) are looked at from Heaven, they appear like Heaven in a less form.
When (Genii) are looked at as to their deceits and cunning, they appear as vipers.
The third (kind of infernal arts) has relation to the communication and influx of the thoughts and affections by conversions, by inspections...
It has been granted to look into the Hells, and to see what they are like within...
To speak according to this appearance: - the Lord sees and looks at everyone face to face...
All conjunction in the Spiritual World is effected by looking at. Explained... The Lord looks at the Angels in the forehead.
By a looking at the brazen serpent... they were healed.
Not look at it () = not at all.
To look at it = to see the quality of the state of life of the one and of the other.
The Lord looks at the Angels in their foreheads... because the Lord looks at from the good of love...
For, in the Spiritual World (the intentions) are drawn out by inspections. LJPost 23:end.
When the Lord's Heaven looks into evil, it is tortured...
Evil Spirits are tortured when the Angels look into them.

An evil Spirit, who was only lightly looked at by the Angels, began to lament... as if in the death agony. A certain one appeared to me to be turned into conglomerations of snakes... SE 2492. SE 2497.
They were not changed into serpents, because they were looked at only by exterior Angels...
If the Angels look into such, they are affected with such straitness that they seem to perish, and seem to themselves to be turned into filthy reptiles and wild beasts. SE 3061.
That such varieties of... faces... originate from the inspection of the Angels.
That a certain one, when looked at from Heaven, was turned into intestines.
How good Spirits appear when looked at by the Angels.
Boys... can scarcely look at one another with a pleasant countenance.
The evil who are in the interior sphere cannot he looked at by the Angels, because they are then turned into serpents, etc.
He was then suddenly inspected by angelic Spirits... and, when inspected, he was suddenly stretched out into a long bandage...
When inspected, she was a more deceitful Subject than they...
As evil Spirits, when inspected by the Angels; and good ones, when inspected by the Angels...
How many evil Spirits around me were inspected by the Angels.
She could allure to adulteries... by looking into the right side of his face...
They appear, when looked at, like serpents.
For the affection is completely varied according to the inspection, or the turning of the face to them.

Thus they cannot be infested by... inspection, and thus by magical infestations. (But) if perchance they were to look at them, the ideas of their thought which penetrate would be bound by certain ones there, and then those who look at them cannot move from the place...
When they look into anyone who worships the Lord, they become as if insane...
Then he looked into them, and poured out his Persuasive into their eyes... LJPost 27.
But I looked into his mouth from truths, and he became as if dead...
When an opportunity is afforded to (Spirits) to look into our Earth, they do not see anything unlike (the scenery there).
To look at the book = to explore these things.
